title: 活动目录备份一致性：等待真实跨文件写事务建立恢复点
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 不同文件在不同时间被读取，结果可能混合多个状态，例如索引引用尚未备份的数据。
需要应用静默、应用原生备份或受控一致性快照来建立恢复点。
文件复制成功并不证明跨文件关联一致。

conversion.original_title: 备份过程中持续变化的目录为何可能无法恢复到某一真实时间点？

body:
## 操作任务
实现capture(source,target)。本题应用合同：所有写者在同一稳定writer.lock inode上持LOCK_EX，更新index.json和data.json后释放；备份者必须持同一文件LOCK_SH覆盖完整读取和复制区间。data.json含generation/value，index.json含同generation及data文件SHA256；不一致时ValueError，不能把混合状态当成功快照。target必须全新，不可覆盖已有恢复点；只复制这两个声明文件，保留mode与mtime，返回{generation,data_sha256}。真实独立写进程会停在index已更新而data尚未更新的中间状态，capture必须等待其完成，不能锁另一个文件或只校验后无锁复制。源数据、稳定锁inode和既有恢复点不被修改。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux flock、独立写者进程、实际文件复制及业务交叉校验；仅证明遵守同一协作锁的声明两文件应用一致性点。不是通用在线文件系统快照，不覆盖绕锁写者、数据库原生备份、Btrfs/LVM、任意文件类型或掉电持久性。区别于摘要清单完整性及单文件原子replace；不构建镜像。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/writer.py:
"""Cooperating two-file writer with deterministic inconsistent intermediate state."""
import fcntl,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);value=sys.argv[2];generation=int(sys.argv[3])
with (root/'writer.lock').open('rb') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 data=json.dumps(dict(generation=generation,value=value),sort_keys=True).encode()
 index=json.dumps(dict(generation=generation,data_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()),sort_keys=True).encode()
 (root/'index.json').write_bytes(index)
 print('WRITER_BETWEEN_FILES_WITH_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK',flush=True)
 assert sys.stdin.readline().strip()=='finish'
 (root/'data.json').write_bytes(data)
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,sys,tempfile,threading,time
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/workspace') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);source=root/'live';source.mkdir()
 (source/'writer.lock').write_bytes(b'');(source/'unrelated.lock').write_bytes(b'')
 lock_inode=(source/'writer.lock').stat().st_ino
 for generation in (1,2):
  previous=json.dumps(dict(generation=generation-1,value='previous'),sort_keys=True).encode()
  (source/'data.json').write_bytes(previous)
  (source/'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(generation=generation-1,data_sha256=hashlib.sha256(previous).hexdigest())))
  for name in ('index.json','data.json'):os.chmod(source/name,0o640);os.utime(source/name,ns=(1700000000000000000,1700000000000000000))
  value=secrets.token_hex(16);target=root/('snapshot-'+str(generation))
  writer=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B','checks/writer.py',str(source),value,str(generation)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
  results=[];errors=[]
  def capture():
   try:results.append(task.capture(source,target))
   except BaseException as error:errors.append(repr(error))
  worker=None
  try:
   assert writer.stdout.readline().strip()=='WRITER_BETWEEN_FILES_WITH_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK'
   assert json.loads((source/'index.json').read_bytes())['generation']!=json.loads((source/'data.json').read_bytes())['generation']
   print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:cooperating_writer_lock_establishes_cross_file_application_cut',flush=True)
   worker=threading.Thread(target=capture);worker.start();time.sleep(.12)
   blocked=worker.is_alive() and not target.exists()
   writer.stdin.write('finish\n');writer.stdin.flush();writer.stdin.close();writer.wait(timeout=3)
   assert writer.returncode==0,writer.stderr.read()
   worker.join(timeout=3)
   assert blocked,'copy did not wait for the actual writer transaction boundary'
   assert not worker.is_alive() and not errors and len(results)==1,(errors,results)
   raw=(target/'data.json').read_bytes();index=json.loads((target/'index.json').read_bytes())
   assert index['generation']==json.loads(raw)['generation']==results[0]['generation']==generation
   assert json.loads(raw)['value']==value and index['data_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==results[0]['data_sha256']
   assert set(p.name for p in target.iterdir())=={'data.json','index.json'}
   for name in ('index.json','data.json'):
    assert (target/name).read_bytes()==(source/name).read_bytes()
    assert (target/name).stat().st_mode&0o777==0o640 and (target/name).stat().st_mtime_ns==(source/name).stat().st_mtime_ns
   assert (source/'writer.lock').stat().st_ino==lock_inode
   try:task.capture(source,target)
   except FileExistsError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('existing recovery point overwritten')
  finally:
   if writer.poll() is None:
    try:writer.stdin.write('finish\n');writer.stdin.flush()
    except (BrokenPipeError,ValueError):pass
    writer.terminate();writer.wait(timeout=3)
   if worker:worker.join(timeout=3)
 print('NATIVE_TWO_REAL_WRITER_GENERATIONS_CONSISTENT_FILES_AND_METADATA',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
